meta.title: 为什么你越引导，客户越尴尬？
meta.title_en: Why Does the More You Direct, the More Awkward the Client Gets?

scenes.title_cn: 问题引出：你是不是总觉得，每次让客人…
scenes.title_en: The problem: do you always find that when …
scenes.context: 引导的关键不是控制动作，而是进入故事场景。
sentences: 每次让客人摆好姿势看镜头的时候，他们做出来的动作都特别僵硬。
Every time you ask clients to pose and look at the lens, they turn stiff.
stiff movements（动作僵硬）
不一定是你的技术不行，而是你的引导方式缺了最关键的一环。
It's not your skills—your direction is missing the key step.
the key step（最关键的一环）
真正高级的引导不是控制动作，而是帮助他们进入一个故事场景。
Truly advanced direction guides them into a story scene, not controlled moves.
story scene（故事场景）
你变成了一位引导家庭情绪的故事讲述者。
You become a storyteller guiding family emotion.
storyteller（故事讲述者）
paraphrase: the key step（最关键的一环
the key step（最关键的一环
scenes.speak: Every time you ask clients to pose and look at the lens, they turn stiff. It's not your skills—your direction is missing the key step. Truly advanced direction guides them into a story scene, not controlled moves. You become a storyteller guiding family emotion.

scenes.title_cn: 第一点：开拍之前先熟悉你的家庭剧本。…
scenes.title_en: Point one: know the family script before s…
scenes.context: 从真实生活细节找剧本，而非强行回忆情绪。
sentences: 引导其实从拍摄前就开始了，你要先了解这个家的故事。
Direction starts before the shoot—learn the family's story first.
start early（提前开始）
孩子最近迷上的动画、经常重复的小游戏，这些小细节比情绪回忆更自然也更真实。
The kid's latest cartoon, a repeated game—these details beat emotional recall.
small details（小细节）
这些生活瞬间就是你拍摄时最真实最自然的素材。
These life moments are your most natural material to shoot.
natural material（自然素材）
scenes.speak: Direction starts before the shoot—learn the family's story first. The kid's latest cartoon, a repeated game—these details beat emotional recall. These life moments are your most natural material to shoot.

scenes.title_cn: 第二点：拍摄过程中捕捉他们的高光情绪…
scenes.title_en: Point two: capture their highlight emotion…
scenes.context: 捕捉而非制造，真实情绪最有力量。
sentences: 好的照片不是摆出来的，而是被观察出来的。
Good photos aren't posed—they're observed.
observed（观察出来）
那一瞬间的温柔一定是摆不出来的。
That moment of tenderness can't be posed.
can't be posed（摆不出来）
放大真实的情绪，永远比制造表情更有力量。
Amplifying real emotion beats manufacturing expressions.
amplify emotion（放大情绪）
scenes.speak: Good photos aren't posed—they're observed. That moment of tenderness can't be posed. Amplifying real emotion beats manufacturing expressions.

scenes.title_cn: 第三点：少给动作指令，多给情境状态。…
scenes.title_en: Point three: give fewer action commands, m…
scenes.context: 把指令换成情境和游戏，自然进入角色。
sentences: 普通家庭客户很少能演情绪，但他们非常擅长玩游戏。
Regular families rarely act emotion, but they excel at games.
games not acting（游戏而非表演）
当你给的不是动作而是情境，他们就会自然地进入角色。
Give a scene, not an action, and they naturally enter the role.
enter the role（进入角色）
最好的引导是轻轻把他们带回到自己真实的状态里。
The best direction gently returns them to their real state.
real state（真实状态）
那些拥抱得很紧的时刻，能把这些真实保存下来，是我们作为摄影师最幸福的事情。
Tight hugs preserved—that's our happiest job as photographers.
preserve the real（保存真实）
paraphrase: games not acting（游戏而非表演
games not acting（游戏而非表演
scenes.speak: Regular families rarely act emotion, but they excel at games. Give a scene, not an action, and they naturally enter the role. The best direction gently returns them to their real state. Tight hugs preserved—that's our happiest job as photographers.

practice: Clients go stiff and fake-smile when directed.
Guide them into a story scene, not a pose.
Learn the family's small real-life details first.
Move your position and record, don't re-pose.
Turn commands into games and situations.
pitfalls: Direct with a story scene, not commands.
喊看镜头笑只会换来假笑。
Use small daily details like cartoons and games.
强行回忆情绪反而尴尬。
Re-pose the moment once it's real.
Move your position and record instead.
真实的瞬间无需打断重摆。
Give action commands to shy clients.
动作指令换情境与游戏。
Return them to their real state and forget the lens.
完美姿势不如真实状态。
shifts: 用 story scene（故事场景）、shooting script（拍摄剧本）、storyteller（故事讲述者）
用 capture highlight emotions（捕捉高光情绪）、observe（观察）、amplify real emotion（放大真实情绪）
用 real emotional threads（真实情绪线索）、family documentary（家庭纪实）、accept（接纳）
